outlets.name: TV Tokyo — Shutsubotsu! Adomachi Tengoku (出没！アド街ック天国)
outlets.credible: national-network TV program (since 1995) that ranks a neighbourhood's top-30 spots; each ranked place has its own broadcaster backnumber page (e.g. 2024-08-17 'Osaka Universal City' episode)

outlets.name: OsakaMania (オオサカマニア, Osaka Metro)
